briefdescription.para: Prepares a text for a single TAP line.

detaileddescription.para: Each line break (\\n, \\r, or the \\r\\n pair) is replaced by a space, so that the text does not end the line. When escape is true, each \\ is written as \\\\ and each # as \\#, as the TAP 14 specification recommends for the test point descriptions and the reasons, so that a # in the text does not start a directive (for example # TODO, which would hide a failure). The # Subtest: comments are not escaped, since the specification defines no escapes in comments, and the node-tap parser uses their text as it is.

parameterdescription.para: Whether to escape the \\ and # characters.

simplesect.para: The text, without line breaks, and escaped if requested.

briefdescription.para: Formats a text as a YAML double-quoted scalar.

detaileddescription.para: The text is enclosed in ", with each \\ written as \\\\, each " as \\", and each control character (including the line breaks, the tab, and DEL) as a YAML escape sequence (\\0, \\t, \\n, \\r, \\e, and so on, or \\xHH for the others), so that the value is a single line, and is valid YAML whatever it contains. As plain scalars, the values starting with {, [, or ', or containing : or #, would be rejected or truncated by the YAML parsers used by the TAP consumers. The bytes above 0x7F are written as they are, since they are expected to be parts of UTF-8 sequences.

briefdescription.para: C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ TAP test reporter member functions.

detaileddescription.para: This source file contains the implementations for reporter_tap, a concrete implementation of the reporter abstract interface that formats test results according to the Test Anything Protocol (TAP), version 14. It is the default reporter, also selected with the --reporter=tap command-line option.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, since the reporters are internal to the framework.
This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.
